# Rennet and curds

Rennet is the enzyme that turns warm milk into a solid curd, the first step of almost every cheese. Add it after the [[Cheese cultures]] have ripened the milk.

Stir diluted rennet into milk at 32 °C, then leave the pot undisturbed for forty minutes until the curd gives a clean break when cut with a knife.

Cut the curd into cubes and stir gently while the whey separates. Small curds give a drier, harder cheese for [[Pressing hard cheese]].
